chain.text: The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients and has 6 consultation rooms. It opens 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturday. Twelve nurses work in three shifts, plus four administrative staff. Accreditation has been held since April 2022 and expires in April 2027. Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records. Attendance averages 180 consultations a day, peaking at 310 in January 2025. The no-show rate is 9 percent, down from 14 percent after September 2024 reminder texts. A March 2024 vaccine fridge failure discarded 2,100 euros of stock. The fridge now has a networked temperature alarm and a paper log backup. In November 2024 a record was double-updated and the allergy field overwritten. The record system now locks a record while it is open. Prescriptions may not be renewed without a consultation within twelve months. Vaccine stock is counted twice weekly, not monthly. Temperature excursions above 8
